method.goal_recovery: Restore complete owner outcome, corrections, hard constraints, current authority and rejected history.
method.decision_loop: Investigate competing causes; trace shared root; compare reuse/adapt/replace/build; challenge the preferred option with counterexamples; choose with evidence.
method.execution_loop: Bounded task -> explicit inputs/outputs -> execute -> inspect actual output -> repair mechanism -> re-run affected and neighboring cases.
method.acceptance: Separate code/structural tests from actual visual, media, user and business outcomes; use independent evidence; preserve UNKNOWN/OPEN when proof is missing.
method.learning: Record symptom, root cause, counterexample, chosen mechanism, rejected alternatives, evidence and applicability limits.
